result.rationale: The proposed 2023 Stonepeak minority holding is disproved. New England Power Company (NEP) is National Grid USA's regulated transmission subsidiary; 'Stonepeak New England Power' was a separate Canal/Bucksport generation portfolio acquired in 2018-2019 and sold to JERA in 2022.

identityResolution.regulatoryDocket: FERC EC22-71; Canal Generating LLC et al., 181 FERC ¶ 61,157

operatingResolution.qualification: Qualifying regulated infrastructure, but not a Stonepeak PortCo.

acquisitionExitCheck.proposedTransaction: No Stonepeak/National Grid announcement, FERC Section 203 matter, SEC/company filing or utility approval supports a 2023 Stonepeak NEP investment.
acquisitionExitCheck.actualTransaction: Canal I-III closed 2018-06-29; Bucksport followed in 2019; the 100% JERA sale was signed May 2022, authorized 2022-11-23 and closed 2022-12-01.
acquisitionExitCheck.price: $320m for Canal I-II; Canal III, Bucksport and exit consideration NOT_PUBLICLY_DISCLOSED.
acquisitionExitCheck.laterCheck: No Stonepeak NEP transfer, buyback, restructuring, exit or pending deal was found through 2026-08-19; NEP reviewed subsequent events through 2026-06-17.

milestones.event: National Grid acquired NEES; NEP remained under renamed National Grid USA.
Stonepeak closed Canal I-III; Canal I-II cost $320m, funded with Fund II equity and debt.
JERA announced its signed 100% acquisition of the 1.63 GW Canal/Bucksport portfolio.
FERC-approved EC22-71 sale of Canal Power Holdings LLC was consummated.
